diagnosis: The desktop sync bridge route reads document drafts from the node:sqlite database using the requested draftId without verifying that the draft's workspace_id matches the authenticated user's workspace membership. An attacker can enumerate draft IDs to read unreleased product roadmaps, confidential meeting transcripts, and pre-publication patent drafts stored on the synchronization server.
exploit_request:
GET /api/sync/drafts/dft_board_merger_confidential HTTP/1.1
Host: sync.notiondesk.internal
Authorization: Bearer standard_contractor_jwt
